title: Great Escape Adventures
gap: Price for escape room not stated
blurb: Guests can play board games from a free-to-play library, participate in collectible card game events, and experience an immersive escape room at the Arnot Mall location. The escape room accommodates groups up to 8 people and lasts 60 minutes. The business also hosts free birthday parties and special occasions with gaming tables available 7 days a week.
